name: Inner Light
body:
Your aetheric soul burns brightly.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, infused

Benefit(s): You may flare your inner reserves of aetheric power to create light. A number of times per day equal to your Charisma bonus you may shed a pale blue glow as light with a caster level equal to your Hit Dice. At 10th level this effect is treated as daylight.
